lines: Three days later. The Neon Arena is sold out. Twenty-two thousand fans, one voice.
She sang her heart out. The crowd sang it back.
But in the shadows, someone was listening very closely.
Las Vegas. Neon and noise. The tour keeps rolling.
Chicago. Cold rain, and a long road.
New York. The final show. The biggest stage of her life.
The lights went out. And so did the world.
Perimeter is secure. Anything you need, boss.
Sir, I think that's enough for tonight.
Pack your things. We're moving tonight.
That was no accident. Somebody cut those brakes.
Nova! Nova! Stay with me!
Hold on. I'm coming. I'm coming for you.
I see the van. Stay on him!
Nobody takes her. Nobody.
Just my voice and a little luck.
Thanks. Do I know you?
Let's keep the tour going. I'm not hiding.
Rex, did you see his face?
Okay. Okay, think. There has to be a way out.
The lock. I can pick it.
A weapon. Finally.
There. The pier. That's my way out.
It's over, Ghost.
I'll never be anyone's prisoner.
Let them see the truth.
I'm home.
Nova Vega. I have followed every show. Every song.
Not yet.
Do you always leave through the east gate?
Good evening, Nova. You never answered my letters.
Don't hurt her. She is the whole show.
You are mine now. The fans never needed you. I did.
You will sing for me. Only for me.
No! This was supposed to be perfect!
Ms. Vega, I'm Agent Ortiz. Someone has been following your tour.
We found the van. Move in, now!
Dante Kane. We've been after him for two years.
It's over, Kane. Hands where I can see them.
Break a leg tonight. We will be in the front row, with ear protection for the kids.
Nova? Nova, where are you? Pick up!
You're safe. You're really safe.
Welcome home, superstar.
Ladies and gentlemen, the Queen of the Neon Skyline, Nova Vega!
New York! Are you ready?!
Something is wrong with the lights! Please remain calm!
Please proceed calmly to the exits!
Get her! Don't let her run!
Boss said no mistakes.
She's over here!
Stop right there!
